probeInterpretation: Cold/trained policies are adaptive during each probe; only initial learned-rule states are transplanted, fatigue/frustration/memory reset. Different prior campaign exposure remains. No human transfer/comprehension claim.

trioInterpretation.chargeDerivation: Derived from each successful family use and the native per-board trio costs, not a separately recorded per-turn charge ledger. Refused drafts spend no native charge/Coins.

manualLearningExposure.note: CognitiveAgent.feedback learns on exit, not skill_flow/skill_pulse; automation changes manual learning exposure. It still applies fatigue for every modeled action.

trioInterpretation.modeledRequestCost: Each request, including refusal, consumes one policy decision and the same uncalibrated duration/fatigue rule; native GUIDE/refusal do not spend a productive-move budget unit.
trioInterpretation.nativeChargeState: Initial3 per board, cap6, +1 per distinct exited tile; one use per slot and one combo after two distinct families. Different from the separate tactical chapter.
trioInterpretation.policyChoice: Pressure is remembered block, visible dead-end warning or >8 present pieces; requests also occur every6th decision. Ready slots are shuffled and sampled; REWIND additionally requires remembered block/dead-end. This is not an optimized scheduler.
trioInterpretation.randomness: Same profile/input seeds are paired. Changed actionIndex, state and exposure change subsequent random draws; this is not the same exact action stream with extra ability effects.
trioInterpretation.scope: Paired total effect of this synthetic policy and environment, not an intrinsic talent nerf or measured human outcome. Contribution of each mechanism is not identified without another policy experiment.
